Maya (CS): FYI Opal Health just complained — after the recent runtime/model update their Patient Search is returning many duplicate records and missing some recent entries. They called it 'stale + aggressive dedupe'. Renewal review in 2 weeks, customer pretty frustrated. Can PM triage?
Ethan (PM): Thanks Maya. Can you drop one representative query + the top 6 results they saw? Also: mark as renewal-risk P1?
Maya (CS): Pasting quick excerpt they shared — query: \"john smith cardiology 2025\" — results (returned order):
```json
[ {"id": "p-123", "name": "John Smith", "last_visit": "2023-11-10"}, {"id": "p-123_old", "name": "John Smith", "last_visit": "2022-09-05"}, {"id": "p-987", "name": "J. Smith", "last_visit": "2024-02-01"}, {"id": "p-123_copy", "name": "John Smith", "last_visit": "2023-11-10"} ]
```
They say the duplicate variants are crowding out the truly recent record (p-987).
Maya (CS): They also mentioned the config we pushed: `model=redwood-v2-encoder; reranker=default; dedupe_threshold=0.85` — their ops team asked if we can temporarily lower the threshold per-tenant.
Kai (Eng): We can expose a per-tenant override for `dedupe_threshold` in the search route. Quick fix: set to `0.6` for Opal to reduce merging. That should be a low-risk runtime flag. I'll need a short change to the routing layer and a config toggle.
Priya (Solutions): +1. For the short-term workaround we can do override; long-term this feels like a product control: per-route dedupe + visual explainability (why two records merged). Recommend adding to feedback tracker as 'per-tenant rerank/dedupe controls' and label as high-impact.
Jared (CS Lead): Please create a customer ticket and add to the renewal playbook. Maya can you confirm the exact date/time of the renewal call and note the ask?
Maya (CS): Renewal call 2025-06-10 14:00 PDT. Confirmed they'll accept a temporary lowering of `dedupe_threshold` if we can push it before the call.
Ethan (PM): I'll own the PM ticket. Kai — can you schedule a 2-hr spike early next week to implement the override? Outcome: (1) runtime toggle deployed to staging for Opal, (2) rollout plan to prod behind a kill-switch, (3) PM epic for product-level controls.
Kai (Eng): Yep, I'll slot it Mon AM.
cs-bot: Created ticket CS-4821 and linked to GH PR #6053. Added row to Customer Feedback tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs-feedback (row id F-2025-034).
Priya (Solutions): Also recommending a short customer note explaining why dedupe changed after model upgrade — helps their trust. I'll draft. :memo:
Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update Opal this afternoon that we have a plan and CS-4821 is in flight. :thumbsup:
Ethan (PM): Putting this on the next product triage board. Will post summary + ETA in this thread once spike is done.
